name: Green Light Manufacturing
old_description: Green Light Manufacturing is a Woman Owned full service Contract Manufacturer founded in 2008 and dedicated to the production of quality Electronic and Electro-Mechanical assemblies. Our Niche is Low to Medium volume High Mix PCB manufacturing of Surface Mount, Plated Thru-Hole assemblies with a Focus on Rapid High Tech Prototype Services.
about:
Green Light Manufacturing was founded in 2008 in Salem, New Hampshire, as a woman-owned contract manufacturer dedicated to producing electronic and electro-mechanical assemblies. The company began with a focus on low- to medium-volume, high-mix printed circuit board manufacturing, covering both surface-mount and plated through-hole technologies, with an emphasis on rapid high-tech prototype services.

The shop offers a range of assembly services including low-medium volume high-mix SMT production, high-speed SMT production, rapid prototyping, repair and rework, depot repair, SMT/BGA technology, leaded and RoHS-compliant processes, high-speed surface mount assembly down to 0201 and micro-BGA packages, custom hand-built prototype and engineering assemblies from 1005 to FPGA components, mixed/hybrid technology, consignment with kit verification, and turnkey assembly. The facility operates with continuously updated manufacturing equipment, though specific machine models are not disclosed.

Green Light serves customers across industrial, communications, military, automotive, commercial, medical, and RF sectors. Industrial clients include manufacturers of controls, ATMs, kiosks, gaming systems, and elevators. Communications customers build routers, switches, transceivers, and fiber-channel equipment. Military programs span space launch vehicles, satellites, and military aircraft. Automotive work covers navigation systems, sensor controls, GPS, and mobile TV. Commercial projects involve set-top boxes, audio/video equipment, and cinematography gear. Medical clients produce consumer medical devices, ultrasound, and medical imaging systems. RF applications include global positioning systems, GPS receivers, and anti-jam technology.

The company states that its differentiation lies in a custom manufacturing solution tailored to exact requirements, with a specific focus on quick-turn SMT prototyping. Quality, continuous improvement, and customer satisfaction are described as the personal responsibility of each team member, guided by the principles of desire, dedication, and determination.
